summary: Implemented scripts/generate-completions.ts with deterministic bash, zsh, and fish renderers driven by the commander definitions, generated the three committed completion files, and added a 9-test unit suite proving byte-identical regeneration, full command/flag coverage, fish-aware drift detection, and the unchanged ten-command surface; typecheck, lint, focused tests, and all 818 unit tests pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented scripts/generate-completions.ts with deterministic bash, zsh, and fish renderers driven by the commander definitions, generated the three committed completion files, and added a 9-test unit suite proving byte-identical regeneration, full command/flag coverage, fish-aware drift detection, and the unchanged ten-command surface; typecheck, lint, focused tests, and all 818 unit tests pass.
decisions: The generator exports describeProgram/renderCompletion/generateCompletions/writeCompletions/findCompletionDrift so the test regenerates into a temp directory without shelling out; the script entry writes completions/ by default.
Help flags are synthesized in the renderers rather than added to the model, so drift checks compare only the documented CLI options.
Fish flags are matched as -l name/-s f in drift detection because fish does not spell flags with leading dashes.
Install locations live in each generated file header, with docs/reference left to docs-engineer.
Generated files preserve commander registration order for stable, reviewable output.
agentReportedTests: npx vitest run tests/unit/completions.test.ts tests/unit/program.test.ts tests/unit/cli-entry.test.ts: 37/37 passed
npm run build and node dist/cli/index.js --help: exit 0, ten commands
npm pack --dry-run: three completion files included
warnings: Completion files are generated artifacts; any manual edit fails tests/unit/completions.test.ts until regenerated.
The generation CLI requires a TypeScript loader (e.g. npx tsx) because the repository imports .js specifiers that resolve to .ts sources; the test path needs no extra tooling.
validationLimitations: zsh and fish are not installed on this host, so those files were structurally validated but not executed by their shells.
The gated packaging install suite was not rerun (npm registry dependency); npm pack --dry-run verified the completion files are in the tarball.
payload.taskDescription: Implement scripts/generate-completions.ts that imports the commander program, walks its commands and options, and emits bash, zsh, and fish completion files into completions/. The script must be deterministic so a test can regenerate into a temporary directory and compare against the committed files. The test fails when a command or flag exists in the CLI but not in the completions, and asserts that no completion subcommand was added.
